title: Linked List Frequency
summary: Given a linked list with k unique elements, generate a new linked list of length k showing the frequency of each unique element from the original list, in any order.
statement: Given a linked list with k unique elements, generate a new linked list of length k showing the frequency of each unique element from the original list, in any order.
constraints: Count each distinct value in the input linked list.
Create and return a new linked list containing one frequency per distinct value.
Any frequency order is accepted; the input nodes must remain unchanged.
reference_solution:
def linked_list_value_frequencies(head):
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter();node=head
    while node:counts[node.val]+=1;node=node.next
    dummy=tail=ListNode()
    for count in counts.values():tail.next=ListNode(count);tail=tail.next
    return dummy.next

hints: Traverse the input once and count values in a hash map.
Allocate one output node for each stored frequency.
Link those new nodes and return the first one.
The counter is exact by induction over visited nodes, and emitting its values produces exactly one frequency per distinct input value.
